name: cadesa
description: Predict what a style edit will do before you make it. Cadesa computes layout without a browser and ships plain CSS.

scripts.build:ts: rm -rf lib && tsc -p tsconfig.json && chmod +x lib/cli.js
scripts.demo: tsx src/cli.ts build settings.cadesa.yaml --out dist/settings.css && tsx src/cli.ts whatif fixtures/settings.html --source settings.cadesa.yaml --widths 390,1280 --set styles.settings-panel.when.narrow.padding=panel
scripts.conformance:css: tsx scripts/conformance.ts --lift fixtures/css/panel.css --fixtures fixtures/css/panel.html --widths 320-1440/10 --out artifacts/css-panel && tsx scripts/conformance.ts --lift fixtures/css/article.css --fixtures fixtures/css/article.html --widths 320-1440/10 --out artifacts/css-article && tsx scripts/conformance.ts --lift fixtures/css/dashboard.css --fixtures fixtures/css/dashboard.html --widths 320-1440/10 --out artifacts/css-dashboard && tsx scripts/conformance.ts --lift fixtures/css/overflow.css --fixtures fixtures/css/overflow.html --widths 320-1440/10 --out artifacts/css-overflow
scripts.conformance:pricing: tsx scripts/conformance.ts --source examples/pricing/pricing.cadesa.yaml --css examples/pricing/pricing.css --fixtures examples/pricing/pricing.html --widths $(seq -s, 300 7 1300) --out artifacts/pricing
scripts.conformance:landing: tsx scripts/conformance.ts --source examples/landing/landing.cadesa.yaml --css examples/landing/landing.css --fixtures examples/landing/landing.html --widths $(seq -s, 300 9 1400) --out artifacts/landing
scripts.conformance:field2: tsx scripts/conformance.ts --source fixtures/field2.cadesa.yaml --css fixtures/field2.css --fixtures fixtures/field2.html --widths $(seq -s, 280 7 1400) --out artifacts/field2
scripts.conformance:fonts: CADESA_METRICS=fixtures/fonts/metrics tsx scripts/conformance.ts --strict --source fixtures/fonts/fonts.cadesa.yaml --css fixtures/fonts/fonts.css --fixtures fixtures/fonts/fonts.html --widths $(seq -s, 280 7 1400) --out artifacts/fonts
